note:
BH-9906: fix rounds this box runs at the same time. The tick counts the live runners (the held locks/fix-round-

-.lock files) and claims at most FIX_ROUND_RUN_MAX - running rows; a row it does not claim stays queued, with no alert. Per-project rows lane.fix-round-claim..FIX_ROUND_RUN_MAX apply: the box uses the minimum over the projects it owns. Does not apply on the Fly pool, where each round has its own machine. 0 = off: the box claims nothing.
